description: This file is a Markdown documentation describing how to implement and configure custom hooks for the LiteLLM proxy server, specifically focusing on pre-call, post-call, and moderation hooks. It provides code examples, usage instructions, and explanations of different hook types and features.

classes.name: MyCustomHandler
classes.description: A custom callback handler class inheriting from CustomLogger, implementing various asynchronous hooks for the LiteLLM proxy to modify requests, responses, and run moderation checks.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Modifies the request data before making the LLM API call, for example, setting a specific model name.

methods.name: async_post_call_failure_hook
methods.description: Handles actions on failure of the LLM call, such as logging errors.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Handles actions after a successful LLM API call, such as response processing.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Runs moderation checks in parallel with the API call; can throw exceptions to reject data.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_hook
methods.description: Modifies streaming responses after they are received.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Allows processing of the entire streaming response as an asynchronous generator.
